description.zh-TW:
Partying 是語音聊天與小遊戲的社交 App。維運者 2026-10-24 直接讀取 Google Play 頁面：發行者為 OLA CHAT PTE LTD，分級為 18 歲以上，含 App 內購買項目，下載 10,000,000 次以上，評分 3.0（約 71,800 則評論）；說明提到交友、語音與視訊聊天、遊戲陪玩，以及歌唱直播的打賞與虛擬禮物。partying.tw 頁面則描述語音聊天、虛擬派對、遊戲、交友配對與音樂，版權標示為 OLA PARTY PTE. LTD.（新加坡）。

兩個名稱看來有關聯：發行者回應 Google Play 評論時留的客服信箱位於 partying.sg 與 mail.olaparty.sg，與 OLA PARTY 的名稱相符。

本站的連結不含邀請碼：點擊「立即註冊」時，本站會先複製活動邀請碼 824981170，再開啟 partying.tw。邀請碼來自分享文案，文案只寫「Partying 活動邀請碼」，沒有說明輸入位置、對象、優惠或期限，所以本頁不列出優惠，也沒有測試過邀請碼是否被接受。分享文案沒有附連結，只看邀請碼無法確認這組碼屬於哪一個 App。

年齡與消費：依 Partying 的隱私權政策，未滿 18 歲（對台灣寫的是未滿 20 歲）註冊或使用須取得法定代理人同意，使用者協議各版本對最低年齡的寫法不一，詳見注意事項。儲值與送禮是實際花費，請量力而為；本站不推薦儲值，也不保證任何收益。Google Play 上有使用者評論（未經查證）指稱身分不實、詐騙與被施壓購買金幣，請提高警覺。實際內容以 Partying 官方公告為準。
description.en:
Partying is a voice-chat and mini-game social app. The maintainer read its Google Play page directly on 2026-10-24: publisher OLA CHAT PTE LTD, age rating 18+, in-app purchases, 10M+ downloads, rating 3.0 from about 71.8k reviews. The description mentions making friends, voice and video chat, game companions, and live singing shows with tips and virtual gifts. The partying.tw page describes voice chat, virtual parties, games, dating matching and music, and its copyright line names OLA PARTY PTE. LTD. (Singapore).

The two names appear to be linked: the developer’s replies to Google Play reviews give support addresses at partying.sg and mail.olaparty.sg, which matches the OLA PARTY name.

The link on this page does not carry the invite code. Selecting “Sign up” first copies activity invite code 824981170 and then opens partying.tw. The code comes from the share text, which reads only “Partying 活動邀請碼” (Partying activity invite code) and does not say where the code is entered, who it is for, what it gives or how long it lasts, so no offer is listed here. Whether the code is accepted was not tested. Because the share text has no link, the code alone cannot confirm which app it belongs to.

Age and spending: under Partying’s privacy policy, people under 18 (the policy gives under 20 for Taiwan) need a legal guardian’s consent to register or use the service, and versions of the user agreement state the minimum age inconsistently; see the notes. Top-ups and gifts cost real money, so spend within your means; this site does not recommend top-ups and does not promise any earnings. Some Google Play reviews (user-written, unverified) allege fake identities, scams and pressure to buy coins, so stay alert. Actual terms follow Partying’s official announcements.

notes.zh-TW:
身分與來源：分享文案只有「Partying 活動邀請碼」，沒有附連結，只看邀請碼無法確認是哪一個 App；本頁參考 Google Play 頁面與 partying.tw。partying.tw 不是邀請專屬頁；iOS 版也找不到台灣上架頁（台灣與美國 App Store 的 id1499589662 頁面都回 404，本站不列 App Store 連結）。

維運者 2026-10-24 開啟 partying.tw，頁面描述這是提供語音聊天、虛擬派對、遊戲、交友配對與音樂的 App，版權標示為 OLA PARTY PTE. LTD.（新加坡）。同日直接讀取 Google Play 頁面，發行者是 OLA CHAT PTE LTD，名稱不同；但發行者回應評論時留的客服信箱位於 partying.sg 與 mail.olaparty.sg，與 OLA PARTY 的名稱相符，顯示兩個名稱有關聯。尚未確認的是這組邀請碼是否屬於此 App，因為分享文案沒有附連結。

年齡與消費：Google Play 分級為 18 歲以上，含 App 內購買項目；隱私權政策寫未滿 18 歲（對台灣寫的是未滿 20 歲）須法定代理人同意，使用者協議各版本對最低年齡的寫法不一，請以官方最新規定為準。虛擬物品與禮物是實際花費，依使用者協議不能退款，透過非官方管道儲值或交易被禁止；隱私權政策與使用者協議的內容取自先前查閱的資料，2026-10-24 複查 help.partying.tw 的網址回 404，無法重現。本站不推薦儲值，也不保證任何收益。若陌生人要求轉到其他通訊軟體或付款，請提高警覺。

使用者評論：Google Play 評分 3.0（約 71,800 則評論）。近期有評論（使用者自行撰寫，本站未查證）指稱身分不實、詐騙與被施壓購買金幣，也有評論說傳私訊要先買金幣；這些不是本站查證的結論，僅作風險提示。

優惠：分享文案沒有提到獎勵，也沒有找到官方說明，所以不列出優惠，也無法確認條款是否允許第三方網站公開邀請碼。名稱相近的 App 不一定相關，請只透過 Google Play 上架頁取得。
notes.en:
Identity and sources: the share text reads only “Partying 活動邀請碼” (Partying activity invite code) with no link, so the code alone cannot confirm which app it belongs to; this page relies on the Google Play page and partying.tw. partying.tw is not an invite page, and no iOS listing was found in Taiwan (the Taiwan and US App Store pages for id1499589662 both returned 404, so no App Store link is listed).

The maintainer opened partying.tw on 2026-10-24: the page describes an app with voice chat, virtual parties, games, dating matching and music, and its copyright line names OLA PARTY PTE. LTD. (Singapore). The Google Play page, read directly the same day, names the publisher as OLA CHAT PTE LTD, a different name; but the developer’s replies to reviews give support addresses at partying.sg and mail.olaparty.sg, which matches the OLA PARTY name and ties the two names together. What remains unconfirmed is whether this invite code belongs to this app, because the share text has no link.

Age and spending: Google Play rates the app 18+ and lists in-app purchases; the privacy policy says people under 18 (under 20 for Taiwan) need a legal guardian’s consent, and versions of the user agreement state the minimum age inconsistently, so follow the latest official rules. Virtual items and gifts cost real money; per the user agreement they cannot be refunded, and top-ups or trades through unofficial channels are prohibited. The privacy policy and user agreement come from earlier checks, and the help.partying.tw addresses returned 404 when rechecked on 2026-10-24, so this cannot be reproduced. This site does not recommend top-ups and does not promise any earnings. Be wary if a stranger asks you to move to another messaging app or to pay.

User reviews: Google Play shows a rating of 3.0 from about 71.8k reviews. Some recent reviews (user-written, not verified by this site) allege fake identities, scams and pressure to buy coins, and one says private messages require buying coins; these are not findings of this site and serve only as a risk signal.

Offer: the share text mentions no reward and no official explanation was found, so none is listed; it also could not be confirmed whether the terms allow third-party sites to publish invite codes. Similarly named apps are not necessarily related; get the app only through the Google Play listing.
